intended_use.primary: Estimate whether a specific reader would benefit from reviewing a sampled word after reading an unseen article.
intended_use.secondary: Study session-level reading performance and process evidence while preserving uncertainty and abstention.

reading_measurement_calibration.purpose: develop and validate task-specific reading measures and their external-anchor relationships

new_bank_target.administration: balanced fixed forms with common anchors and alternate-form retest

personalized_word_fusion.purpose: test incremental personalized word-review prediction on unseen people and articles

cognitive_covariate_add_on.purpose: study one justified cognitive moderator without changing the primary fusion decision

legacy_data_policy.scope: sessions collected before the v3 protocol, content bank, and split manifest were frozen

personalized_word_review_recommendation.scope: post-reading sampled-word review need on unseen readers and articles

reading_comprehension_session.scope: performance on the administered form only

lexical_knowledge.promotion_requires: authorized external lexical anchor plus reliability and validity evidence

english_reading_proficiency.promotion_requires: independent standardized reading criterion and confirmation data

cefr.promotion_requires: formal CEFR specification, standard setting, and empirical linking study

working_memory.promotion_requires: authorized validated task, separate-session reliability, and convergent/discriminant validity

typography_preference.promotion_requires: separate matched and counterbalanced typography experiment

construct_map.evidence: post-reading response collected without exposing gaze or model scores
accuracy and response time on independently authored sentence verification items
accuracy on explicit, inferential, cohesive, and source-evaluation items
authorized validated instrument administered independently of LexiGaze text and gaze
construct_map.score_use: validation and personalization covariate, never automatic CEFR

construct_map.evidence: quality-gated word and passage observables conditioned on text and capture context
authorized validated working-memory task with its own scoring contract
construct_map.score_use: task-specific score only; no cognitive composite

modules.implementation: versioned research questionnaire covering L1, age of acquisition, exposure, education band, vision correction, and recent standardized-test history
calibration and continuous capture-quality audit; failure causes gaze abstention, not participant exclusion from non-gaze analyses
fixed-form sentence meaning checks with accuracy and monotonic-clock response time
balanced incomplete-block assignment with fixed typography and no adaptive routing
sampled words rated no_review, unsure, or review_needed after each passage; model and gaze outputs remain hidden
instrument choice and reuse authorization must be frozen before collection
authorized validated working-memory task on a different day or counterbalanced session; no composite score

content_requirements: multiple genres, domains, and discourse structures
two independent human reviews before model scores are revealed
item families include explicit, inference, lexical_cohesion, and source_evaluation
passage-linked items analyzed as testlets rather than assumed locally independent

word_probe_sampling.selection: frozen stratified probability sample over eligible content words

promotion_requires: lower primary-metric loss than every eligible comparator on joint participant-and-passage confirmation
two-way participant-and-passage resampling interval for the loss difference excludes zero
no direction reversal on participant-only, passage-only, and capture-session holdouts
calibration is no worse than the best comparator
gaze-missing and low-quality cases safely fall back to f1_text_person
subgroup and device results disclose uncertainty and abstain where support is insufficient

calibration_and_validation.sample_size_policy: freeze separate measurement-calibration and fusion-confirmation simulations for parameter precision, primary-effect power, attrition, cluster count, and subgroup cells; no universal n threshold
cat_activation_requires: adequate information across the intended score range
independent confirmation that CAT preserves score interpretation and fairness

future_requirements: one GPU job at a time
peak VRAM and wall time logged
fixed candidate list and early stopping before outcome access
no language-model fine-tuning on participant outcomes

readiness_blockers: ethics approval or exempt determination for the revised procedures
authorized external lexical and reading anchors
versioned reading-measurement bank and 48-family fusion pool with independent human review
updated consent, retention, and withdrawal documents
